description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPUser class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the correct setting and serialization of LDAPUser properties, including integration with LDAP lookup settings and employee selector mappings.

classes.name: LDAPUserTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LDAPUser, verifying property setting, serialization, and LDAP lookup setting integration.

methods.name: testLDAPUser
methods.description: Tests creating an LDAPUser object, setting properties, and verifying its serialization as a hex string.

methods.name: testLDAPUserWithLookupSetting
methods.description: Tests LDAPUser object with LDAP lookup settings and employee selector mappings, verifying serialization includes these configurations.
